title: Wrong Access VLAN
symptoms: PC cannot ping its default gateway
user_report: My computer has an IP address but cannot access the network
relevant_config: interface Fa0/10 | switchport mode access | switchport access vlan 20
expected_behavior: PC should be assigned to VLAN 10
root_cause: Access port is assigned to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10
correct_fix: Configure Fa0/10 as an access port in VLAN 10

title: VLAN Not Created
symptoms: PC cannot communicate with other devices in the same VLAN
user_report: The VLAN is configured on the port but communication fails
relevant_config: interface Fa0/10 | switchport mode access | switchport access vlan 30
expected_behavior: VLAN 30 should exist on the switch
root_cause: VLAN 30 has not been created
correct_fix: Create VLAN 30 and assign the required access port

title: Trunk Not Configured
symptoms: Devices in the same VLAN on different switches cannot communicate
user_report: The two switches are connected but VLAN traffic is not passing
relevant_config: interface Gi0/1 | switchport mode access
expected_behavior: The inter-switch link should carry multiple VLANs
root_cause: Inter-switch connection is configured as an access port instead of a trunk
correct_fix: Configure the inter-switch link as a trunk

title: VLAN Missing From Allowed Trunk
symptoms: VLAN 20 devices cannot communicate across switches
user_report: Other VLANs work but VLAN 20 does not
relevant_config: interface Gi0/1 | switchport mode trunk | switchport trunk allowed vlan 10
expected_behavior: VLAN 20 should be carried across the trunk
root_cause: VLAN 20 is missing from the allowed VLAN list
correct_fix: Allow VLAN 20 on the trunk

title: Native VLAN Mismatch
symptoms: Trunk link reports native VLAN mismatch
user_report: The switches show connectivity warnings
relevant_config: SW1 native VLAN 10 | SW2 native VLAN 20
expected_behavior: Both trunk interfaces should use the same native VLAN
root_cause: Native VLAN values do not match
correct_fix: Configure the same native VLAN on both trunk interfaces

title: Incorrect DHCP Pool Network
symptoms: PC receives no valid IP address
user_report: My PC keeps getting an incorrect IP address
relevant_config: ip dhcp pool USERS | network 192.168.20.0 255.255.255.0
expected_behavior: Clients should receive addresses from the 192.168.10.0/24 network
root_cause: DHCP pool references the wrong network
correct_fix: Change the DHCP pool network to 192.168.10.0/24

title: Incorrect DHCP Exclusion
symptoms: Available DHCP addresses are unexpectedly limited
user_report: Only a small number of clients can obtain addresses
relevant_config: ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.10.1 192.168.10.250
expected_behavior: Only reserved addresses should be excluded
root_cause: Most of the DHCP pool has been excluded
correct_fix: Reduce the excluded address range

title: DHCP Server Unreachable
symptoms: Remote clients do not receive DHCP addresses
user_report: Clients on another subnet cannot obtain an IP
relevant_config: DHCP server is on 192.168.20.10
expected_behavior: DHCP requests should reach the remote server
root_cause: Routing or relay configuration prevents DHCP requests reaching the server
correct_fix: Restore routing and DHCP relay connectivity

title: Missing DHCP Relay
symptoms: Clients receive no address from remote DHCP server
user_report: The DHCP server works for its local subnet but not another subnet
relevant_config: interface G0/1 | no ip helper-address 192.168.20.10
expected_behavior: DHCP broadcasts should be relayed to the server
root_cause: ip helper-address is missing
correct_fix: Configure ip helper-address on the client-facing interface

title: DHCP Pool Exhaustion
symptoms: New clients cannot obtain an IP address
user_report: Existing clients work but new devices cannot connect
relevant_config: DHCP pool contains only a small number of usable addresses
expected_behavior: The pool should have sufficient addresses for clients
root_cause: All available DHCP addresses have been allocated
correct_fix: Expand the DHCP address pool or release unused leases

title: Incorrect DNS Server
symptoms: Websites cannot be reached by hostname but IP addresses work
user_report: Internet works when I use an IP address but not a website name
relevant_config: DNS server 192.168.99.10
expected_behavior: Client should use the correct DNS server
root_cause: Client is configured with an invalid DNS server
correct_fix: Configure the correct DNS server address

title: Missing DNS Record
symptoms: Specific hostname does not resolve
user_report: One internal application name cannot be found
relevant_config: No A record exists for app.company.local
expected_behavior: Hostname should resolve to the application server
root_cause: Required DNS record is missing
correct_fix: Create the required DNS record

title: DNS Server Unreachable
symptoms: DNS queries time out
user_report: Clients cannot resolve any hostnames
relevant_config: DNS server is unreachable from client subnet
expected_behavior: DNS server should be reachable through the network
root_cause: Routing or ACL prevents DNS traffic from reaching the server
correct_fix: Restore network connectivity and permit DNS traffic

title: Incorrect Domain Configuration
symptoms: Short hostnames fail to resolve
user_report: Fully qualified names work but short names do not
relevant_config: ip domain-name wrong.local
expected_behavior: Client should use the correct DNS search domain
root_cause: Incorrect domain/search configuration is used
correct_fix: Configure the correct domain/search suffix

title: ACL Blocks HTTP
symptoms: Web server cannot be reached over HTTP
user_report: I can ping the server but the webpage does not open
relevant_config: access-list 101 deny tcp any host 192.168.20.10 eq 80
expected_behavior: HTTP traffic should reach the web server
root_cause: ACL explicitly denies HTTP traffic
correct_fix: Permit required HTTP traffic in the ACL

title: ACL Applied in Wrong Direction
symptoms: Unexpected traffic is blocked
user_report: The ACL exists but affects the wrong traffic flow
relevant_config: ip access-group 101 in
expected_behavior: ACL should inspect the intended traffic direction
root_cause: ACL is applied in the wrong direction
correct_fix: Apply the ACL in the correct direction

title: Incorrect Source Network
symptoms: Authorized users cannot access the server
user_report: Users from the correct subnet are being denied
relevant_config: access-list 110 permit ip 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 any
expected_behavior: Users from 192.168.10.0/24 should be permitted
root_cause: ACL permits the wrong source network
correct_fix: Correct the ACL source network

title: Implicit Deny
symptoms: Only explicitly permitted traffic works
user_report: Some required traffic is silently blocked
relevant_config: ACL contains permit for one service but no required permit for another
expected_behavior: Required traffic should be explicitly allowed
root_cause: Traffic reaches the implicit deny at the end of the ACL
correct_fix: Add the required permit statement before the implicit deny

title: Missing NAT Inside
symptoms: Internal users cannot access external networks
user_report: Internet access fails for LAN clients
relevant_config: LAN interface has no ip nat inside
expected_behavior: LAN interface should participate as NAT inside
root_cause: Inside interface is not marked for NAT
correct_fix: Configure ip nat inside on the LAN interface

title: Missing NAT Outside
symptoms: NAT translations are not functioning
user_report: Internal traffic reaches the router but external access fails
relevant_config: WAN interface has no ip nat outside
expected_behavior: WAN interface should participate as NAT outside
root_cause: Outside interface is not marked for NAT
correct_fix: Configure ip nat outside on the WAN interface

title: Incorrect NAT ACL
symptoms: Some internal hosts cannot access the Internet
user_report: Only certain subnets are translated
relevant_config: access-list 1 permit 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
expected_behavior: Correct internal subnet should be translated
root_cause: NAT ACL matches the wrong subnet
correct_fix: Correct the NAT ACL to match the internal network

title: Missing NAT Overload
symptoms: Multiple internal clients cannot share the public IP
user_report: One client works but multiple clients fail
relevant_config: ip nat inside source list 1 interface G0/0
expected_behavior: Multiple clients should use the public interface address
root_cause: NAT overload/PAT is missing
correct_fix: Configure NAT overload using the WAN interface

title: Missing Static Route
symptoms: Remote network cannot be reached
user_report: I can reach the local network but not the remote network
expected_behavior: Router should have a route to the remote network
root_cause: Static route is missing
correct_fix: Add a static route to the remote network

title: Incorrect Next Hop
symptoms: Traffic is sent toward the wrong router
user_report: The destination network is known but packets do not arrive
expected_behavior: Next hop should point to the neighboring router
root_cause: Static route uses an incorrect next-hop address
correct_fix: Configure the correct next-hop address

title: Incorrect Subnet Mask
symptoms: Route does not match the intended destination network
user_report: Some destinations are reachable while others are not
expected_behavior: Route should represent the complete destination network
root_cause: Incorrect subnet mask is used
correct_fix: Correct the route's subnet mask

title: OSPF Network Statement Error
symptoms: OSPF neighbor or route is missing
user_report: The interface is up but the network is not advertised
relevant_config: router ospf 1 | network 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
expected_behavior: Correct interface network should participate in OSPF
root_cause: OSPF network statement does not match the interface network
correct_fix: Correct the OSPF network statement

title: OSPF Area Mismatch
symptoms: OSPF neighbors do not form
user_report: Both routers run OSPF but remain in INIT/DOWN state
relevant_config: R1 uses area 0 | R2 uses area 1
expected_behavior: Neighboring interfaces should use compatible OSPF areas
root_cause: OSPF area values do not match
correct_fix: Configure the interfaces in the same OSPF area

title: Incorrect SSID
symptoms: Client cannot find the expected wireless network
user_report: The Wi-Fi network name is missing
relevant_config: SSID is configured as Office-Guest
expected_behavior: Client should see the Office-Staff SSID
root_cause: Access point uses an incorrect SSID
correct_fix: Configure the correct SSID

title: Incorrect Wi-Fi Password
symptoms: Client authentication fails
user_report: My device sees Wi-Fi but cannot connect
relevant_config: Configured WPA2 password differs from client password
expected_behavior: Client and AP should use the same credentials
root_cause: Incorrect wireless password
correct_fix: Configure matching wireless credentials

title: WLAN DHCP Failure
symptoms: Wireless client connects but receives no IP address
user_report: Wi-Fi connects successfully but has no network access
relevant_config: Wireless VLAN has no working DHCP service
expected_behavior: Wireless clients should receive an IP address
root_cause: DHCP service is unavailable for the wireless network
correct_fix: Restore DHCP service for the wireless subnet

title: Wireless Security Mismatch
symptoms: Client cannot authenticate
user_report: The network is visible but authentication fails
relevant_config: AP uses WPA2 while client expects incompatible security
expected_behavior: Client and AP should use compatible security settings
root_cause: Security modes do not match
correct_fix: Configure compatible wireless security

title: VLAN and DHCP Failure
symptoms: Client is in the correct VLAN but receives no IP address
user_report: The VLAN looks correct but DHCP doesn't work
relevant_config: VLAN 10 exists but DHCP relay is missing
expected_behavior: Client should receive an address from the VLAN 10 DHCP scope
root_cause: DHCP relay is missing on the VLAN gateway
correct_fix: Configure the appropriate ip helper-address

title: ACL and DNS Failure
symptoms: Users can reach servers by IP but not hostname
user_report: DNS stops working after an ACL change
relevant_config: ACL denies UDP/TCP port 53
expected_behavior: DNS queries should be permitted to the DNS server
root_cause: ACL blocks DNS traffic
correct_fix: Permit required DNS traffic through the ACL

title: NAT and Routing Failure
symptoms: NAT appears configured but Internet is unreachable
user_report: Translations do not result in successful Internet access
relevant_config: NAT configured but no default route exists
expected_behavior: Router should have a route toward the ISP
root_cause: Default route is missing
correct_fix: Configure the correct default route

title: Trunk and Inter-VLAN Routing Failure
symptoms: Some VLANs cannot reach their gateway
user_report: The trunk is active but one VLAN cannot communicate
relevant_config: Router subinterface for VLAN 20 is missing
expected_behavior: Each required VLAN should have a functioning gateway
root_cause: Router-on-a-stick subinterface is missing
correct_fix: Create the correct subinterface with VLAN encapsulation and IP address
